why.title: Why
why.text: Redmond Heritage Farm exists to provide high quality raw dairy products, eggs, and meat to the surrounding community in Utah.

who.title: Who
who.text: Redmond's Heritage Farm team includes the farmers and the dairy cows, pigs, and chickens they care for! Our caretakers incorporate intentional, regenerative farming methods to ensure happy and healthy animals. They also develop and produce our signature farm products.

what.title: What
what.text: Raw dairy, eggs, and meat raised with care and shaped by regenerative methods that keep nutrient density at the center.

why.title: Why
why.text: Redmond Farm Markets exist to provide our communities with nourishing products from our farm, production kitchen, and like-minded suppliers.

who.title: Who
who.text: Our market teams include floor staff who facilitate day-to-day store operations and support staff who focus on purchasing, development, and management.

what.title: What
what.text: Redmond Markets serve our communities by connecting people with nourishing farm-raised products, House Made creations, and products from thoughtful suppliers.

why.title: Why
why.text: Redmond Farm Kitchen was created to provide a high-quality, nutrient-dense dining option for the local community. When dining in one of our Kitchens, customers enjoy meals sourced primarily from the Heritage Farm, Production Kitchen, and other local partners. This creates a culture that prioritizes intentionally sourced and prepared foods.

who.title: Who
who.text: Our kitchen associates prepare, cook, and serve delicious, nutrient-dense foods and drinks to our customers. Whether ringing up a customer, prepping food for the grill, or taking out the trash, kitchen employees work together to improve processes and keep the restaurant running smoothly while providing an amazing customer experience.

what.title: What
what.text: Redmond Farm Kitchen brings nutrient density, convenience, and flavor together into a casual dining experience where customers feel welcomed and cared for.

why.title: Why
why.text: Redmond Farm Market Truck was created to expand the accessibility of our Heritage Farm products throughout Utah and to perpetuate community education around nutrient-dense, traditional foods.

who.title: Who
who.text: The Redmond Farm Market Truck's team typically travels long distances and works long days to bring Redmond Farms products to locations without a nearby Farm Market. A big part of being on the Farm Market Truck team is building relationships with regular customers and keeping up with communication and updates if the truck has downtime.

what.title: What
what.text: Our Farm Market Truck is a mini Redmond Market on wheels! Servicing about five stops each week, it allows us to bring our farm staples and House Made products to our customers who don't live near a store location.

why.title: Why
why.text: The Redmond Production Kitchen generates the House Made product line and supports the Farm Kitchens by storing and creating nutrient-dense food made from scratch. Providing products that we fully trust allows our customers to fully trust us!

who.title: Who
who.text: Our Production Kitchen team creates our House Made items for the kitchens and markets. Production Kitchen associates spend most of their time creating new products, preparing food, and making recipes in large batches. The Production Kitchen team works with our markets and kitchens to ensure that the flow of House Made items is efficient and meeting current needs.

what.title: What
what.text: The Redmond Production Kitchen creates scratch (or "House") made items and ships them to the different Redmond Farm market and kitchen locations. These House Made items include sprouted corn chips, cinnamon almonds, custards, salad dressings made with avocado oil, and so much more!

why.title: Why
why.text: The Redmond Freight Trucks connect and transfer products between Farm Market and Kitchen locations in a safe and reliable way.

who.title: Who
who.text: Our freight truck team works hard to ensure products go where they need to! The team drives two trucks between our Heritage Farm, Production Kitchen, and Market/Kitchen location to transport farm products, House Made items, and other ingredients to and between locations.

what.title: What
what.text: Redmond Farms currently has two refrigerated box delivery trucks that deliver farm products and distribute goods between stores. Three times per week, the truck team transports farm products and frozen meat (sourced from cows raised in Southern Utah and packaged by our meat-packing partner) to the Production Kitchen and Markets. They then drive to Springville to move House Made items and other products (like fries and sauces) from the Production Kitchen to the Market and Kitchen locations. The truck also completes additional transfers between locations and takes milk to the state-certified lab for testing.
